prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic streetwear editorial portrait of an approved adult woman in a gritty industrial alley.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long thick wavy hair held by a white headband, neutral soulful expression, wearing an oversized bubblegum-pink fleece tracksuit over a white long-sleeve layer, silver rings, layered chains, watch, and bracelets. She sits in a balanced full squat with one hand on her knee; any cigarette is incidental and non-glamorized.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium portrait against grey cinder-block wall and weathered asphalt, vibrant pink against monochrome industrial background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft flat overcast daylight, minimal harsh shadows, detailed fabric weave and concrete texture, cinematic nonchalant editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic raw-style 50mm portrait, vertical framing, sharp subject, subtle depth, realistic anatomy and fine grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical 50mm streetwear portrait of an approved adult woman with long wavy hair held by a white headband and a neutral confident expression. She wears an oversized bubblegum-pink fleece tracksuit over a white long-sleeve layer with silver jewelry, and sits in a balanced full squat with one hand on her knee; keep any cigarette incidental and non-glamorized. Place her against a grey cinder-block wall and weathered asphalt under soft overcast light. Use detailed fabric weave, realistic concrete, subtle grain, and nonchalant editorial mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, glamorized smoking, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted body
